items.text: TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut today vs. Saints.
items.implication: Must-start TE if rostered; season debut.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets as primary TE; Mayer handcuff reverse.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane has been ruled out vs. the Chiefs due to a knee injury (exited early, Q to return then OUT).
items.why: Knee injury mid-game; confirmed ruled out.
items.implication: Zero remaining production; check IR/next week.
items.opportunity: Ollie Gordon handles RB duties (Wright inactive).

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout that looked good; true GTD earlier with team not counting on him.
items.why: Pregame workout positive; Schefter confirmed active.
items.implication: Startable if rostered but likely limited usage per Rapoport.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets possible but reduced volume; reverse Bateman/Andrews boost.

items.text: Risky for sure but if Flowers is active for Baltimore he's active for me. I would start him over Bateman.
items.why: Active status overrides risk for Berry.
items.implication: Prefer Flowers in lineups over secondary options.

items.text: Jets WRs today in Detroit with Mitchell inactive: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Jamaal Pritchett 4. Sterling Shepard 5. Malik McLain. Also expecting TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide decent amount.
items.why: Mitchell out confirmed; depth chart shift.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 volume spike potential.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Wilson and depth; Sadiq versatile.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore (shoulder Q) expected to play and confirmed active vs Chargers.
items.opportunity: Normal-ish routes/targets with Keon Coleman also up.

items.text: Flowers out in projections (late Bateman/Andrews swap possible); projecting Warren/Evans/Bowers IN despite Q; Moore in but limited, Mitchell out.
items.implication: DFS late swap alert for Flowers; start expected INs.
items.opportunity: Moore limited snaps; Mitchell absence boosts Wilson.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins OUT second straight (hamstring); decent chance return Week 4 vs Dallas.
Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5, Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.opportunity: High carries/red-zone vs weak run D.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches +15% targets both games, RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit tgts both games, 14.8 aDOT 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% tgt share last week w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most yds to TEs.
Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/gm 3.2 YPC.
